system: MEKSAT — Mekong Spaceborne Analytics & Telemetry (Mekong Sense)

branches.title: Mekong Cascade Dams & Hydropower Telemetry
branches.coreEngine: Constrained QP Water Balance + RTS Smoother + Dynamic Hypsometry + SCS 4-Pillars
branches.summary: Full telemetry of 419 Mekong dams (H, A, V, Qin, Qout) with mass conservation and strict residual solving.

branches.title: Basin-wide Calibrated Satellite Precipitation
branches.coreEngine: 3-Layer Bias Correction (DBS Gamma + GPD Extreme Tail + QDM Trend) + Thiessen Assimilation
branches.summary: 1,339 continuous days of bias-corrected and ground-assimilated precipitation across 16 Mekong sub-basins.

branches.title: Tonle Sap Lake Storage & Inundation Dynamics
branches.coreEngine: Dual-Polarization Flooded Forest Mask + Discrete Overpass Alignment + Reverse Flow Hydraulics
branches.summary: Tonle Sap storage dynamics, flooded forest SAR extraction, and reverse pulse regulation to the Mekong Delta.

branches.title: Upstream Irrigation Schemes & Agricultural Water Use
branches.coreEngine: Multi-Temporal NDVI/NDWI Phenology Thresholding + Consumptive Irrigation Forcing
branches.summary: Mapping upstream irrigation schemes, canal commands, and independent crop consumptive demand.

branches.title: Mekong Delta Rice Phenology & Sowing Progress
branches.coreEngine: Temporal Scattering Amplitude Curve Fitting (Soil Preparation -> Flooding -> Heading -> Harvest)
branches.summary: Tracking 3-crop rice sowing, flooding, and vegetative progress across 13 Mekong Delta provinces.

branches.title: Mekong Delta InSAR Land Subsidence Geodesy
branches.coreEngine: Persistent Scatterer Interferometry (PSI) + Small Baseline Subset (SBAS)
branches.summary: Measuring millimeter-scale coastal and deltaic land subsidence from excessive groundwater extraction.

branches.title: Dynamic Cropping Patterns & LULC Evolution
branches.coreEngine: Spectral Angle Mapper (SAM) + Random Forest Multi-Spectral Classification
branches.summary: Annual and seasonal land use transition matrices, aquaculture expansion, and mangrove tracking.

branches.title: Mekong Delta Flood Inundation & Rapid Emergency Mapping
branches.coreEngine: Two-Tier Adaptive Thresholding + HAND Mountain Mask + Rapid Inundation Extent
branches.summary: Rapid emergency flood extent delineation and historical inundation depth archives.

branches.title: Actual Evapotranspiration (ETa) & Consumptive Use
branches.coreEngine: Energy Balance Inversion (SEBAL / METRIC) + Thermal Radiance Calibration
branches.summary: Consumptive water depletion and agricultural actual evapotranspiration modeling.

branches.title: Satellite Root-Zone Soil Moisture & Drought
branches.coreEngine: Tau-Omega Radiative Transfer Model + Soil Moisture Deficit Index (SMDI)
branches.summary: Root-zone soil moisture retrieval for agricultural drought early warning and irrigation scheduling.

branches.title: Tien & Hau River Morphology & Sandbar Dynamics
branches.coreEngine: MNDWI Water-Land Boundary Extraction + Sub-pixel Edge Displacement Tracking
branches.summary: High-resolution bankline erosion detection, thalweg shifts, and sandbar morphological changes.

branches.title: Estuarine Salinity Intrusion 4g/l Dynamics
branches.coreEngine: Machine Learning Surrogate Modeling + Tidal Hydrodynamic River Reach Assimilation
branches.summary: Tidal estuarine salinity boundary forecasting and freshwater intake protection.

branches.title: Tidal Sluice Gate Operations & Coastal Infrastructure
branches.coreEngine: SAR Specular Reflection Double-Bounce Signature (Open vs Closed Gate Metal Structure)
branches.summary: Automated radar detection of tidal sluice gate operation (Cai Lon - Cai Be, Ba Lai) and salinity barricades.
